answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the tide is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Every claim climbs the timber of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the orchard re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
